requirements.quote:
An endpoint uses a RESET_STREAM frame (type=0x04) to abruptly
   terminate the sending part of a stream.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint abruptly terminates the sending part of a stream using RESET_STREAM
requirements.required_behavior: Use a RESET_STREAM frame with frame type 0x04.
requirements.why_checkable: A frame encoder or parser can be checked for the fixed RESET_STREAM type value and its stream-termination use.

requirements.quote:
After sending a RESET_STREAM, an endpoint ceases transmission and
   retransmission of STREAM frames on the identified stream.  A receiver
requirements.condition: After an endpoint sends a RESET_STREAM for an identified stream
requirements.required_behavior: Cease transmission and retransmission of STREAM frames on that stream.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not transmit or retransmit further STREAM frames on the identified stream.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime test can send RESET_STREAM and verify that no subsequent original or retransmitted STREAM frame is emitted for that stream.

requirements.quote:
retransmission of STREAM frames on the identified stream.  A receiver
   of RESET_STREAM can discard any data that it already received on that
   stream.
requirements.condition: When a receiver has received RESET_STREAM for a stream
requirements.required_behavior: Permit already-received data on that stream to be discarded.
requirements.why_checkable: The receiver's post-reset stream state can be tested to confirm that buffered data may be released without further processing.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint that receives a RESET_STREAM frame for a send-only stream
   MUST terminate the connection with error STREAM_STATE_ERROR.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint receives a RESET_STREAM frame for a send-only stream
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not continue the connection or accept the frame as valid for that stream.
requirements.error_behavior: Use STREAM_STATE_ERROR when terminating the connection.
requirements.why_checkable: A focused protocol test can inject RESET_STREAM on a send-only stream and verify connection termination and the exact error code.

requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding a RESET_STREAM frame
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the frame as, in order: Type, Stream ID, Application Protocol Error Code, and Final Size.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not omit, duplicate, or reorder the listed fields.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded frame layout and parser consumption order can be compared directly with the specified field sequence.

requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding the Type field of a RESET_STREAM frame
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the Type field as a variable-length integer with value 0x04.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not identify a RESET_STREAM frame with a Type value other than 0x04.
requirements.why_checkable: The field encoding form and fixed numeric value are directly inspectable in serialized frames.

requirements.quote:
Stream ID:  A variable-length integer encoding of the stream ID of
      the stream being terminated.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding the Stream ID field of a RESET_STREAM frame
requirements.required_behavior: Encode it as a variable-length integer identifying the stream being terminated.
requirements.why_checkable: A codec test can verify both the variable-length integer representation and that the decoded identifier selects the terminated stream.

requirements.quote:
Application Protocol Error Code:  A variable-length integer
      containing the application protocol error code (see Section 20.2)
      that indicates why the stream is being closed.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding the Application Protocol Error Code field of a RESET_STREAM frame
requirements.required_behavior: Encode it as a variable-length integer containing the application protocol error code that indicates why the stream is being closed.
requirements.why_checkable: A codec test can verify the variable-length integer representation and preservation of the supplied application error code.

requirements.quote:
Final Size:  A variable-length integer indicating the final size of
      the stream by the RESET_STREAM sender, in units of bytes; see
      Section 4.5.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding the Final Size field of a RESET_STREAM frame
requirements.required_behavior: Encode it as a variable-length integer giving the sender-declared final stream size in bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: A codec test can verify the variable-length integer representation and that the numeric value is interpreted in bytes as the final stream size.
